group.title: Coffee-tasting workshop
group.passage:
Bean Studio — Introductory tasting

Sunday, 2–4 p.m. Maximum eight participants.

Learn to compare aroma, acidity, and body using three coffees prepared by our instructor. This is a tasting session, not a barista-certification course. No brewing equipment is required from participants.

The fee includes all tasting samples and a small bag of coffee beans to take home. Please avoid strong perfume, as it may interfere with other participants’ ability to notice the coffee aromas. A light snack will be served halfway through the session.

Bookings can be cancelled for a full refund until 6 p.m. on Friday. After that deadline, you may transfer your place to another person, but refunds are not available.
group.passageZh:
Bean Studio——入門品飲

星期日下午兩點至四點，最多八人。

透過講師準備的三款咖啡，學習比較香氣、酸度及醇厚度。這是品飲活動，不是咖啡師認證課程。參加者不需攜帶沖煮設備。

費用包含所有品飲樣品及一小袋可帶回家的咖啡豆。請避免使用濃烈香水，以免影響其他人辨識咖啡香氣。課程進行一半時會提供小點心。

最遲在星期五下午六點取消可全額退款。期限後可把名額轉讓給他人，但不能退款。
